messages:
Olivia (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: consolidate why we won/lost on enterprise deals. Short bullets pls.
Sam (AE): Win: dedicated pool SLA + predictable TCO messaging closed a fintech pilot. Loss: no private control plane -> legal rejected.
Maya (CS): Onboarding churn = SSO + missing sample apps for embeddings. Customers ask for turnkey reference app.
Priya (Product): Noted asks: 1) VPC onboarding path 2) SAML + KMS examples 3) Pricing for high-throughput rerankers
Ethan (Eng): Technical note: VPC manual trial doable in ~2 weeks; automated infra needs 6-8 weeks. SAML/KMS docs are quick.
Sam (AE): Also flagged: model-context ask (longer windows) and clearer quantization guidance in sales playbook.
Olivia (CEO): Can someone own a 2-week deliverable set: docs + one-pager + top-10 customer asks?
Priya (Product): I'll own the one-pager and checklist.
Ethan (Eng): I'll create SAML/KMS doc PR and a minimal VPC trial runbook.
Maya (CS): I'll prepare the sample embedding app + demo script for SEs.
ops-bot: Reminder: add tickets to /projects/allhands-customer-followups with label all-hands-priority.
Olivia (CEO): Thanks — please update the board by EOD Friday. Keep items small and testable. :rocket:
